label: Re-routing the fork route's box K node off the packed GOD_4 leaf
summary: Issue #1926 phase 0, second half. QUESTION: can the cheapest root route 8df2faad (cost 16) be made to expand its box K node cdf897a8 without the bare leaf b9816722 (RootFactsForBearer, which carries the existence and attributes of GOD_4 as one leaf), by letting the fork route consume a derivation of cdf897a8 from the quarta-via classical GOD_4 root da3facd6 or another unpacked derivation? APPROACH: the projection da3facd6 to cdf897a8 was proved (result f4395e76, attempt 6becc920) and registered as a strength order. It is an assembly, so it expands nothing in the route-cost diagnostic. Independently of that, the --routes rule (docs/corpus-model.md) expands an intermediate conclusion through the verified non-transcription proof whose leaf union is smallest, chosen greedily per statement. On the merged head (main 62bb4ce3c plus this batch) the packed bundle 0b9f4b1c has union 4 (e068a626, 48366fb2, ab83e6d3, b9816722). Any derivation with a union above 4 loses to it. Every existing derivation of cdf897a8 that does not run through b9816722 costs at least 35: the unpacked bundle a693bf86 costs 43, the projection from da3facd6 costs 35 and is a transcription, and the naming-node bundle 25135d6e (cost 6) runs back through cdf897a8 and so through b9816722 (cost 45 without 0b9f4b1c). The listed transcription 25bfe291 (cost 1, from the actualist K node 7f24ce4d) expands nothing. Any derivation from da3facd6 costs at least cost(da3facd6) = 35, the union of its cheapest derivation 379399d1. A new derivation would win only with a union not above 4 that avoids b9816722 (exactly 4 only if it wins the tie order), and no candidate of that size is known. RESULT: no derivation-level re-routing is available. The fork route keeps expanding cdf897a8 through 0b9f4b1c; its cost 16 is a packing artifact (55 = 22 bare + 6 supported + 27 proved when 0b9f4b1c is removed in a scratch copy; then the cheapest route is 88671579, cost 26). b9816722 stays a legitimate direct-assumption support option; this is no judgment of its warrant.
blocker: The greedy minimum-leaf-union route-cost rule picks the packed bundle 0b9f4b1c (union 4, with b9816722) over every unpacked derivation (at least 35), and an assembly never expands a statement. Removing the packing from the diagnostic needs a rule-level change, for example a computed view or a rule for premises that pack conjuncts of their argument's conclusion (#1926 phase 4, owner decision), not another derivation.
